blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur — The construction of the proposed P100 million sports facility in Dinagat Islands province has gained traction as Philippine Sports Commission (PSC) chairman Patrick Gregorio led Monday the inspection of the proposed site. Dinagat Islands Gov. Nilo Demerey Jr. and local officials welcomed Gregorio and accompanied him for the survey at the proposed sports complex site in Sitio Mahangin, Barangay Wilson in the capital town of San Jose. Project blueprints detail a standard 400-meter, eight-lane all-weather rubberized synthetic track enclosing a central pitch designed for football and other field events.
